elements.name: Spirit Seeker
elements.desc: Cast beast sense and speak with animals, but only as rituals.

elements.name: Totem Spirit
elements.desc: Choose a totem animal (bear, eagle or wolf) that adds a benefit to your rage.

elements.name: Aspect of the Beast
elements.desc: Gain a magical benefit from a totem animal of your choice.

elements.name: Spirit Walker
elements.desc: Cast commune with nature as a ritual, with an animal spirit appearing to you.

elements.name: Totemic Attunement
elements.desc: Gain a rage benefit from a totem animal of your choice.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Valor)
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

elements.name: Combat Inspiration
elements.desc: Allies can use your Bardic Inspiration die on damage rolls or to raise their AC against an attack.

elements.name: Battle Magic
elements.desc: After casting a bard spell with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

elements.name: Blessings of Knowledge
elements.desc: Learn two languages and gain two skills of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion, with double proficiency bonus on them.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
elements.desc: Read a creature's surface thoughts, then cast suggestion on it without a slot.

elements.name: Potent Spellcasting
elements.desc: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.

elements.name: Visions of the Past
elements.desc: Meditate to see the history of an object or your surroundings.

elements.name: Light Bonus Cantrip
elements.desc: Learn the light cantrip.

elements.name: Warding Flare
elements.desc: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
elements.desc: Dispel magical darkness and deal radiant damage to nearby hostile creatures.

elements.name: Improved Flare
elements.desc: Use Warding Flare to protect others too.

elements.name: Corona of Light
elements.desc: Emit sunlight that gives enemies disadvantage on saves against your fire and radiant spells.

elements.name: Acolyte of Nature
elements.desc: Learn a druid cantrip and gain one of Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Nature)
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
elements.desc: Charm beasts and plants within 30 feet.

elements.name: Dampen Elements
elements.desc: Reaction: grant resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Nature)
elements.desc: Once per turn, add 1d8 cold, fire or lightning damage to a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Master of Nature
elements.desc: Command creatures charmed by Charm Animals and Plants.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Martial)
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

elements.name: Wrath of the Storm
elements.desc: Reaction: a creature that hits you takes lightning or thunder damage on a failed Dexterity save.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
elements.desc: Deal maximum lightning or thunder damage instead of rolling.

elements.name: Thunderbolt Strike
elements.desc: Push Large or smaller creatures up to 10 feet when you deal lightning damage.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Tempest)
elements.desc: Once per turn, add 1d8 thunder damage to a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Stormborn
elements.desc: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed outdoors.

elements.name: Blessing of the Trickster
elements.desc: Give a willing creature advantage on Stealth checks for an hour.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
elements.desc: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself that you can cast spells through.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
elements.desc: Become invisible until the end of your next turn.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Trickery)
elements.desc: Once per turn, add 1d8 poison damage to a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Improved Duplicity
elements.desc: Create up to four duplicates with Invoke Duplicity.

elements.name: War Priest
elements.desc: Make a weapon attack as a bonus action after using the Attack action.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
elements.desc: Add +10 to one of your attack rolls.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: War God’s Blessing
elements.name: Channel Divinity: War God’s Blessing
elements.desc: Reaction: grant +10 to an attack roll of a creature within 30 feet.

elements.name: Divine Strike (War)
elements.desc: Once per turn, add 1d8 damage of the weapon's type to a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Avatar of Battle
elements.desc: Gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

elements.name: Combat Wild Shape
elements.desc: Use Wild Shape as a bonus action and spend spell slots to heal while transformed.

elements.name: Circle Forms
elements.desc: Transform into beasts of higher challenge rating.

elements.name: Primal Strike
elements.desc: Your attacks in beast form count as magical.

elements.name: Elemental Wild Shape
elements.desc: Spend two uses of Wild Shape to become an elemental.

elements.name: Thousand Forms
elements.desc: Cast alter self at will.

elements.name: Combat Superiority
elements.desc: Learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8); regain dice on a short or long rest.

elements.name: Student of War
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan’s tools.

elements.name: Know Your Enemy
elements.desc: Learn how a creature compares to you after observing it for a minute.

elements.name: Improved Combat Superiority
elements.desc: Superiority dice become d10 (d12 at 18th level).

elements.name: Relentless
elements.desc: Regain a superiority die when you roll initiative with none left.

elements.name: Eldritch Knight Spellcasting
elements.desc: Cast abjuration and evocation wizard spells using Intelligence.

elements.name: Weapon Bond
elements.desc: Bond with up to two weapons and summon them to your hand.

elements.name: War Magic
elements.desc: After casting a cantrip, make a weapon attack as a bonus action.

elements.name: Eldritch Strike
elements.desc: A creature you hit has disadvantage on its next save against your spells.

elements.name: Arcane Charge
elements.desc: Teleport up to 30 feet when you use Action Surge.

elements.name: Improved War Magic
elements.desc: After casting any spell, make a weapon attack as a bonus action.

elements.name: Shadow Arts
elements.desc: Spend ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence, and learn minor illusion.

elements.name: Shadow Step
elements.desc: Bonus action: teleport 60 feet between dim or dark spaces, then gain advantage on a melee attack.

elements.name: Cloak of Shadows
elements.desc: Use your action to become invisible in dim light or darkness.

elements.name: Opportunist
elements.desc: Reaction: attack a creature that was hit by someone else.

elements.name: Disciple of the Elements
elements.desc: Learn elemental disciplines fueled by ki, including elemental spells.

select.name: Elemental Discipline
ids: Class Feature:Fangs of the Fire Snake
Class Feature:Rush of the Gale Spirits

select.name: Elemental Discipline
ids: Class Feature:Clench of the North Wind

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Nature’s Wrath
elements.desc: Restrain a creature with spectral vines.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
elements.desc: Turn fey and fiends within 30 feet.

elements.name: Ancients Oath Spells
elements.desc: Always have your oath spells prepared.

elements.name: Aura of Warding
elements.desc: You and nearby allies have resistance to spell damage.

elements.name: Undying Sentinel
elements.desc: Drop to 1 hit point instead of 0 once per long rest.

elements.name: Elder Champion
elements.desc: Transform for a minute with regeneration, faster spells and a debuffing aura.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
elements.desc: Frighten a creature and slow it, with a Wisdom save.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
elements.desc: Gain advantage on attacks against one creature for a minute.

elements.name: Vengeance Oath Spells
elements.desc: Always have your oath spells prepared.

elements.name: Relentless Avenger
elements.desc: Move after hitting with an opportunity attack.

elements.name: Soul of Vengeance
elements.desc: Reaction: attack a creature under your Vow of Enmity when it attacks.

elements.name: Avenging Angel
elements.desc: Gain wings, a flying speed and a frightening aura for an hour.

elements.name: Arcane Trickster Spellcasting
elements.desc: Cast enchantment and illusion wizard spells using Intelligence.

elements.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
elements.desc: Your mage hand is invisible and can pick pockets and locks.

elements.name: Magical Ambush
elements.desc: Targets have disadvantage on saves against spells you cast while hidden.

elements.name: Versatile Trickster
elements.desc: Use mage hand to gain advantage on attacks against a creature.

elements.name: Spell Thief
elements.desc: Reaction: negate a spell cast at you and steal it for 8 hours.

elements.name: Wild Magic Surge
elements.desc: After casting a spell of 1st level or higher, the DM may have you roll for a wild magic surge.

elements.name: Tides of Chaos
elements.desc: Gain advantage on one roll, then risk a wild magic surge.

elements.name: Bend Luck
elements.desc: Spend 2 sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's roll.

elements.name: Controlled Chaos
elements.desc: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and choose either result.

elements.name: Spell Bombardment
elements.desc: Roll one damage die again when you roll its maximum.

elements.name: Fey Presence
elements.desc: Charm or frighten creatures in a 10-foot cube around you.

elements.name: Misty Escape
elements.desc: Reaction: turn invisible and teleport 60 feet when you take damage.

elements.name: Beguiling Defenses
elements.desc: Immune to charm, and you can turn charm attempts back on the caster.

elements.name: Dark Delirium
elements.desc: Plunge a creature into an illusory realm, charming or frightening it.

elements.name: Awaken Mind
elements.desc: Communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet.

elements.name: Entropic Ward
elements.desc: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you, then gain advantage on your next attack against that creature if it misses.

elements.name: Thought Shield
elements.desc: Your thoughts can't be read, and you reflect psychic damage back at attackers.

elements.name: Create Thrall
elements.desc: Charm an incapacitated humanoid until the effect is removed.

elements.name: Abjuration Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy abjuration spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Arcane Ward
elements.desc: Create a ward with hit points equal to twice your wizard level plus Intelligence modifier.

elements.name: Projected Ward
elements.desc: Reaction: let your ward absorb damage dealt to a creature within 30 feet.

elements.name: Improved Abjuration
elements.desc: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made for abjuration spells such as counterspell.

elements.name: Spell Resistance
elements.desc: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

elements.name: Conjuration Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy conjuration spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Minor Conjuration
elements.desc: Conjure a small inanimate object that lasts an hour.

elements.name: Benign Transposition
elements.desc: Teleport 30 feet or swap places with a willing creature.

elements.name: Focused Conjuration
elements.desc: Taking damage can't break your concentration on a conjuration spell.

elements.name: Durable Summons
elements.desc: Creatures you summon or create gain 30 temporary hit points.

elements.name: Divination Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy divination spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Portent
elements.desc: After a long rest, roll foretelling d20s you can use to replace attack rolls, saves or ability checks.

elements.name: Expert Divination
elements.desc: Regain a lower-level spell slot when you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher.

elements.name: The Third Eye
elements.desc: Gain darkvision, ethereal sight, greater comprehension or see invisibility until you rest.

elements.name: Greater Portent
elements.desc: Roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

elements.name: Enchantment Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy enchantment spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Hypnotic Gaze
elements.desc: Charm and daze a creature within 5 feet with a Wisdom save.

elements.name: Instinctive Charm
elements.desc: Reaction: redirect an attack against you to a nearby creature.

elements.name: Split Enchantment
elements.desc: Your single-target enchantment spells can target a second creature.

elements.name: Alter Memories
elements.desc: Make a charmed creature unaware it was charmed and make it forget some time.

elements.name: Illusion Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy illusion spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Improved Minor Illusion
elements.desc: Learn minor illusion and create both a sound and an image with it.

elements.name: Malleable Illusions
elements.desc: Change the nature of an illusion with a duration of a minute or more.

elements.name: Illusory Self
elements.desc: Reaction: an attack against you automatically misses.

elements.name: Illusory Reality
elements.desc: Make one inanimate object in your illusion real for a minute.

elements.name: Necromancy Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy necromancy spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Grim Harvest
elements.desc: Regain hit points when you kill a creature with a spell.

elements.name: Undead Thralls
elements.desc: Add animate dead to your spellbook; your undead are tougher and hit harder.

elements.name: Inured to Undead
elements.desc: Resistance to necrotic damage and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

elements.name: Command Undead
elements.desc: Take control of an undead creature with a Charisma save.

elements.name: Transmutation Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy transmutation spells into your spellbook.

elements.name: Minor Alchemy
elements.desc: Temporarily change an object between wood, stone, iron, copper and silver.

elements.name: Transmuter’s Stone
elements.desc: Create a stone that grants darkvision, speed, Constitution save proficiency or resistance.

elements.name: Shapechanger
elements.desc: Cast polymorph on yourself without a slot, into a beast of CR 1 or lower.

elements.name: Master Transmuter
elements.desc: Consume your stone for a powerful one-time effect.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Assassin)
elements.desc: Gain proficiency with the disguise kit and poisoner’s kit.

elements.name: Assassinate
elements.desc: Advantage against creatures that haven’t acted yet, and hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.

elements.name: Infiltration Expertise
elements.desc: Build a false identity over seven days and 25 gp.

elements.name: Impostor
elements.desc: Mimic another person’s speech, writing and behavior after studying them.

elements.name: Death Strike
elements.desc: Double the damage of an attack against a surprised creature that fails a Constitution save.

elements.name: Ranger’s Companion
elements.desc: Gain a beast companion that fights beside you and uses your proficiency bonus.

elements.name: Exceptional Training
elements.desc: Command your beast to Dash, Disengage or Help as a bonus action; its attacks are magical.

elements.name: Bestial Fury
elements.desc: Your beast can make two attacks or use Multiattack.

elements.name: Share Spells
elements.desc: Spells you cast on yourself also affect your beast within 30 feet.

elements.name: Elemental Attunement
elements.desc: Use your action to briefly control elemental forces within 30 feet for minor effects.
